summary: A handheld message pager: ESP32-S3 board with a 2.9 inch e-paper panel, a keypad behind an I2C GPIO expander, a speaker, a haptic motor, a piezo and a LiPo cell, in a printed two-part shell. Wi-Fi now, LoRa as a stretch goal.

voltage_class.source: USB VBUS while charging; a single LiPo otherwise.

application.description: A personal message pager. Nothing safety-related depends on it.
